title: Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
ADDENDA <Act No. 8138, Dec. 30, 2006>
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2007; provided, the amended provisions of Article 2 (1) 2 shall enter into force on July 1, 2007.
Article 2 (General applicability)
This Act shall apply to the taxable articles that are shipped out from a manufacturing place or declared for importation on or after the date this Act takes effect.
Article 3 (Transitional measures)
The previous provisions shall govern the traffic tax imposed or to be im- posed under the previous provisions at the time this Act enters into force.
Article 4 (Transitional measures concerning additional tax)
The previous provisions shall govern the additional tax on traffic tax im- posed or to be imposed under the previous provisions of Article 11 before the enforcement of this Act.
Article 5 (Amendment of other Acts)
(1) The Act on the Adjustment of National and Local Taxes is partially amended as follows:
In Article 2, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
(2) The Act on Temporary Special Cases concerning the Customs Act and Other Acts pursuant to the Implementation of the Agreement under Article IV of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America regarding Facilities and Areas and the Status of United States Armed Forces in the Republic of Korea is partially amended as follows:
In Article 1, "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
In the main text of Article 6, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
The heading of Article 12, "(Tax bases for value-added tax, special consumption tax, liquor tax and traffic tax)", is replaced by "(Tax bases for value-added tax, special consumption tax, liquor tax and traffic, energy and environment tax)"; in the former part of that Article, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax", and "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
(3) The Act on Designation and Management of Free Trade Zones is partially amended as follows:
In Article 2 subparagraph 6, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
In Article 45 (1), "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
(4) The Punishment of Tax Offenses Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 9 (1) 1, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
In Article 12-3 (1), "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
(5) The Restriction of Special Taxation Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 3 (1) 10, "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
The heading of Article 113, "(Procedures for reduction or exemption of special consumption tax and traffic tax, etc.)", is replaced by "(Procedures for reduction or exemption of special consumption tax and traffic, energy and environment tax, etc.)"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax"; in paragraph (3) of that Article, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax", and "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
In Article 140 (2) 2 and 3 and paragraph (3) of that Article, each occurrence of "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
(6) The Local Tax Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 29 (1) 5-2, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
In Article 196-16, "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax", and "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
In Article 196-17 (1), "amount of traffic tax" is replaced by "amount of traffic, energy and environment tax"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, "traffic tax rate" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax rate".
In the former part of Article 196-18 (1), "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act"; in the former and latter parts of that paragraph, each occurrence of "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
The heading of Article 196-20, "(Application mutatis mutandis of the Traffic Tax Act)", is replaced by "(Application mutatis mutandis of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act)"; in the former and latter parts of that Article, each occurrence of "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act".
In Article 196-21, "amount of traffic tax" is replaced by "amount of traffic, energy and environment tax", and "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
(7) The Debtor Rehabilitation and Bankruptcy Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 179 subparagraph 9 (b) and Article 583 (1) 2 (b), each occurrence of "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
(8) The Special Consumption Tax Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 20 (8), "articles subject to traffic tax" is replaced by "articles subject to traffic, energy and environment tax", and "amount of traffic tax" is replaced by "amount of traffic, energy and environment tax".
(9) The Trucking Transport Business Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 29 (2) 1, "Traffic Tax Act" is replaced by "Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act", and "traffic tax" is replaced by "traffic, energy and environment tax".
Article 6 (Relations with other statutes)
Where other statutes cite the previous Traffic Tax Act and the provisions thereof at the time this Act enters into force, if any corresponding provisions are included in this Act, they shall be construed to have cited this Act or the corresponding provisions thereof in lieu of the previous provisions.
